oh/columbus.heading: About 7 Brew in Columbus, Ohio
oh/columbus.html:
7 Brew Coffee has expanded its drive-thru-only footprint across the Columbus metro area with four stands serving the central Ohio market. Founded in Rogers, Arkansas in 2017, 7 Brew is known for its fast, friendly barista service and a menu built around espresso breve drinks — espresso poured over half-and-half instead of regular milk — along with energy drinks, Italian sodas, smoothies, and shakes.

The Columbus locations are spread across key corridors: the Sawmill Road stand near Polaris serves the northern suburbs, the North High Street stands cover the Clintonville and Worthington areas, and the Georgesville Road location anchors the west side. Most Columbus stands open between 5:30 and 6:00 AM and stay open until 11:00 PM seven days a week, making them one of the earliest coffee options in the city.

First-time visitors can explore the full 7 Brew menu with prices before pulling into the drive-thru lane. Popular starting orders include the Blondie (vanilla and caramel breve), the 7 Energy line for a non-coffee caffeine boost, and any drink from the secret menu. Every drink can be customized with sugar-free syrups or alternative milk options. Use the nutrition calculator to check calories before ordering, and download the 7 Brew app for rewards and mobile ordering.

Columbus coffee lovers comparing 7 Brew to other local drive-thru chains will notice the breve base gives drinks a richer, creamier texture than standard espresso drinks. Check our sizes and caffeine guide to compare the 16 oz small, 24 oz medium, and 32 oz large cups.

tx/dallas.heading: About 7 Brew in Dallas, Texas
tx/dallas.html:
7 Brew Coffee entered the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex as part of its aggressive Texas expansion, with the Coit Road stand in far north Dallas serving as the city's first location. The Arkansas-born drive-thru chain — founded in Rogers in 2017 and now operating 877 stands nationwide — has announced plans for additional DFW locations, including converted former Salad and Go sites along Ross Avenue.

Dallas-area customers can expect 7 Brew's signature breve-style espresso drinks, where half-and-half replaces regular milk for a richer, creamier coffee. The full menu spans hot and iced espresso drinks, blended shakes, 7 Energy drinks, Italian sodas, and smoothies. Browse the complete 7 Brew menu with current prices to plan your order.

With Texas heat driving demand for cold drinks most of the year, the most popular Dallas orders tend to be iced breves and blended options. Try the Blondie over ice, a frozen Smooth 7, or any of the secret menu creations trending on TikTok. Every order can be adjusted with sugar-free syrups at no extra charge — check our calorie calculator to customize.

DFW commuters should note that most 7 Brew stands open as early as 5:30 AM, making them a convenient stop before hitting I-635 or the Dallas North Tollway. Compare cup sizes and caffeine content to pick the right size for your morning drive.

tx/houston.heading: About 7 Brew in Houston, Texas
tx/houston.html:

Founded in Rogers, Arkansas in 2017, 7 Brew has grown to 877 locations across 38 states, with Texas being one of its largest markets.

The Houston stands serve the full 7 Brew menu, including signature espresso breves made with half-and-half, 7 Energy drinks with caffeine and B-vitamins, Italian sodas, smoothies, teas, and shakes. Houston's warm climate makes iced and blended drinks the go-to choice for most of the year — the Blondie on ice and frozen Banana Bread latte are local favorites.

First-time visitors should check our best 7 Brew drinks guide for a ranked list of what to order. The drive-thru experience is fast — most visits take under five minutes — and baristas are known for helping newcomers customize their order on the spot. You can swap to sugar-free syrups or oat milk at no extra charge, and use the nutrition calculator to see how changes affect calories.

Both Houston locations typically open at 5:30 AM and close at 10:00 PM daily. Download the 7 Brew app for rewards, and compare sizes and caffeine to decide between the 16 oz, 24 oz, and 32 oz cups.

in/indianapolis.heading: About 7 Brew in Indianapolis, Indiana
in/indianapolis.html:
Indianapolis has three 7 Brew drive-thru stands spanning the south and southeast side of the metro — on South East Street, East County Line Road, and South Emerson Avenue. Indiana is one of 7 Brew's strongest Midwest markets with 30 locations statewide, and the Indy stands give Circle City commuters a fast alternative to traditional coffee shops.

7 Brew's menu revolves around breve-style espresso drinks, where half-and-half replaces regular milk for a noticeably creamier cup. Beyond espresso, the full menu includes 7 Energy drinks, Italian sodas, smoothies, hot chocolate, and shakes — all available in three sizes. Check our sizes and caffeine guide to compare the 16 oz small, 24 oz medium, and 32 oz large.

Popular orders for Indianapolis first-timers include the Blondie (vanilla-caramel breve), the Brunette (hazelnut-mocha), and any secret menu drink you've seen on TikTok — just tell the barista the recipe. Every drink can be made with sugar-free syrups, and our calorie calculator lets you compare options before you arrive.

ky/lexington.heading: About 7 Brew in Lexington, Kentucky
ky/lexington.html:
Lexington has four 7 Brew drive-thru stands covering the city from multiple directions — Remington Drive in the Hamburg area, Clay Mills Road near I-75, Harrodsburg Road on the southwest side, and Richmond Road serving the eastern neighborhoods. With Kentucky hosting over 30 7 Brew locations statewide, the Lexington cluster gives Bluegrass-area coffee drinkers easy access to the chain's signature breve-style espresso drinks.

7 Brew's breve base — espresso pulled over steamed half-and-half — sets it apart from most drive-thru coffee chains. The result is a thicker, creamier drink with a natural sweetness that requires less added sugar. Browse the complete 7 Brew menu with prices to see every category, from hot and iced espresso to 7 Energy drinks, Italian sodas, and shakes.

Lexington locals looking for a first order should try the Blondie or the Cookie Butter — both are rich without being overpowering. For a non-coffee pick, the 7 Energy line delivers caffeine and B-vitamins without espresso. Check our best drinks guide for ranked recommendations, and use the calorie calculator to compare sizes and milk options.

Most Lexington stands open around 5:30 AM and stay open until 10:00 or 11:00 PM daily. The full syrup list includes sugar-free options for keto and low-carb diets. Grab a printable menu PDF to browse the lineup before your next visit.

ar/rogers.heading: About 7 Brew in Rogers, Arkansas — Where It All Started
ar/rogers.html:
Rogers, Arkansas is where the 7 Brew story began. Founded in 2017 by Ron and Jori Crume, the very first 7 Brew drive-thru opened here in Northwest Arkansas, and the brand's headquarters remain in nearby Springdale. What started as a single stand has grown into a national chain with 877 locations across 38 states — but the Rogers stands are still the hometown originals.

The Rogers locations on South 52nd Street and West Walnut Street serve the Northwest Arkansas metro alongside stands in neighboring Bentonville, Fayetteville, and Springdale. The menu here is the same one served nationwide: breve-style espresso drinks made with half-and-half, 7 Energy drinks, Italian sodas, smoothies, teas, and shakes. Browse the complete 7 Brew menu with prices to see every category.

As the birthplace of 7 Brew, Rogers is where many of the signature drinks were first developed. The Blondie, Brunette, and Smooth 7 all originated from this market. First-time visitors should also explore the secret menu — locals here have been creating custom combinations since 2017. Customize any drink with sugar-free syrups, and use the calorie calculator to compare options.

Rogers stands typically open at 5:30 AM and close at 10:00 PM daily. Check our best drinks ranking, compare cup sizes and caffeine content, and download the 7 Brew app for rewards. This page is an independent guide — for official hours and app ordering, use the stand links above.
